arguments.command:
set -eu
BASE=/home/storage/781/4477781/user/webapp
PY="$BASE/envs/openwebui/bin/python"
DB="$BASE/openwebui-data/webui.db"
"$PY" - <<'PY'
import sqlite3, json
p="/home/storage/781/4477781/user/webapp/openwebui-data/webui.db"
c=sqlite3.connect("file:"+p+"?mode=ro",uri=True)
c.execute("PRAGMA query_only=ON")
print("INTEGRITY="+c.execute("pragma integrity_check").fetchone()[0])
for k in ("task.model.default","task.model.external","task.model.params"):
    print(k+"="+repr(c.execute('select value,updated_at from config where "key"=?',(k,)).fetchone()))
ids=("local-agent-mini-c-agent","qwen2.5-coder:1.5b-instruct-q4_K_M","granite4.2:3b","gemma3:270m","deepseek-r1:1.5b-qwen-distill-q8_0","qwen3:4b-instruct")
rows=c.execute("select id,name,base_model_id,params,updated_at from model where id in (%s) order by id" % ",".join("?"*len(ids)), ids).fetchall()
for row in rows:
    print("MODEL="+json.dumps({"id":row[0],"name":row[1],"base_model_id":row[2],"params":json.loads(row[3]) if row[3] else None,"updated_at":row[4]},separators=(",",":")))
c.close()
PY
echo '--- OLLAMA_EFFECTIVE ---'
pid="$(pgrep -f "$BASE/miniconda/bin/ollama serve" | head -n1 || true)"
if [ -n "$pid" ]; then
  tr '\0' '\n' < "/proc/$pid/environ" | grep -E '^OLLAMA_(KEEP_ALIVE|CONTEXT_LENGTH|MAX_LOADED_MODELS|NUM_PARALLEL|NUM_THREAD)=' | sort || true
fi
echo '--- API_PS ---'
curl -fsS --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/ps || true; echo
echo '--- WARM_CRON_COUNT ---'
(crontab -l 2>/dev/null | grep -F -c "$BASE/runtime-domains/automation/warm-residency.sh" || true)
echo '--- WARMER_EXISTS ---'
[ -f "$BASE/runtime-domains/automation/warm-residency.sh" ] && echo yes || echo no
